candidates.title: Draft order updates from changing store data

demandEvidence.chore: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’d be interested to hear how others handle customer-facing status updates when internal operational data is incomplete or changes frequently.

ease.reason: A sample status row can support a beginner draft test; no supplied building source documents store connections.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: online shops may pay for clearer order updates; this discussion proves neither buyers nor payment.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop can prepare drafts, but a person must verify changing facts and approve messages.

evidence.reason: The request names changing customer-facing updates but gives no frequency, data fields or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold on provisional mean (4.6) and duplicate of recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6: same ecommerce customer and customer-communication workflow. Recent rejection assessed this exact identity; new evidence adds no implementation support.
